[[File:Carbonitedrillingmachine.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A carbonite drilling machine]]
A '''drill''' was a mechanical device used for boring into the ground. The [[Nuiwit]] of [[Altor 14]] used mechanical drills to open underground [[Water/Legends|water]] reservoirs.
